title: Animals
subtitle: a cow, a calf, beef; pets and wild animals
summary: Name farm animals, wild animals and pets, and say what farm animals give us and what their babies are called.

lesson.heading: Farm animals
lesson.note: The meat often has a different name from the animal: cow gives us beef, pig gives us pork.

lesson.heading: Wild and zoo animals
lesson.text: In a zoo, or in hot countries, you can see a **monkey**, a **tiger**, a **giraffe**, a **snake**, a **lion**, an **elephant** and a **tortoise**.

examples.text: A **giraffe** has a very long neck.
A **tortoise** goes to sleep in winter.
You can ride a horse and an **elephant**.

lesson.heading: Pets
lesson.text: A **pet** is an animal you keep at home. The most popular pets are a **dog**, a **cat**, a **rabbit**, a **fish** and a **parrot**. A parrot is a **bird**.

examples.text: **Rabbits** are very good at hopping and jumping.

lesson.heading: Looking after animals
lesson.text: You must **feed** your animals and **give them water** every day. You **take** a dog **for a walk**.

examples.text: **Take** your dog **for a walk** every day.
Don't forget to **feed** the cat and to **give** it some water.

lesson.text: Sheep and fish are the same in the singular and the plural: one sheep, ten sheep - not ~~ten sheeps~~.

exercises.prompt: Match the farm animal with its baby.
Match the animal with the meat it gives us.
A ___ has a very long neck.
exercises.explanation: A giraffe is the animal with the very long neck.

exercises.prompt: A ___ has a hard shell on its back and goes to sleep in winter.
exercises.explanation: A tortoise sleeps all through the winter.

exercises.prompt: Tigers and ___ are large wild cats.
exercises.explanation: Lions and tigers are both big cats.

exercises.prompt: ___ are very good at hopping and jumping, and they have long ears.
Which of these animals is a bird?
exercises.explanation: A parrot is a bird. Hens and chickens are birds too.

exercises.prompt: Don't forget to ___ the cat and to give it some water.
exercises.explanation: We feed an animal when we give it food.

exercises.prompt: I ___ my dog for a walk every day before school.
exercises.explanation: We take a dog for a walk.

exercises.prompt: You can ride a horse and an ___.
exercises.explanation: Horses and elephants are big enough to ride.

exercises.statement: My uncle keeps ten sheeps and two goats on his farm.
exercises.explanation: My uncle keeps ten sheep and two goats on his farm. Sheep is the same in the singular and the plural.

exercises.prompt: Is it a farm animal, a wild animal or a pet?
Ask a friend about the animals they keep at home.
exercises.explanation: A pet is an animal you keep at home.
